# windows_legacy_package (Data Source)

Reads the observed state of a legacy Windows package (MSI or EXE installer) without managing its lifecycle. Exactly one of `product_id` (MSI ProductCode GUID) or `display_name` (exact EXE `DisplayName`) must be provided as the lookup key.

Install-only attributes of the sibling resource (`installer_type`, `source_path`, `source_url`, `checksum`, `install_args`, ...) are intentionally absent.

Returns an error when no matching package is found in the Uninstall registry hives.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Look up an installed MSI package by its ProductCode GUID.
data "windows_legacy_package" "seven_zip" {
  product_id = "{23170F69-40C1-2702-2502-000001000000}"
}

output "seven_zip_installed" {
  value = data.windows_legacy_package.seven_zip.installed
}

output "seven_zip_version" {
  value = data.windows_legacy_package.seven_zip.installed_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Exact `DisplayName` of an EXE install as recorded in the Uninstall registry hive (verbatim, case-sensitive match). Exactly one of `product_id` or `display_name` must be specified.
- `product_id` (String) MSI **ProductCode** GUID. Exactly one of `product_id` or `display_name` must be specified.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier: ProductCode GUID for MSI, resolved exact DisplayName for EXE.
- `install_date` (String) Install date from registry InstallDate, normalized to ISO-8601 when parseable.
- `installed` (Boolean) Whether the package is currently detected on the host (always true when the lookup succeeds).
- `installed_version` (String) DisplayVersion read from the Uninstall registry entry.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
